narrative: A hockey player in a reddish-orange and white uniform with "FuboTV" in a big logo on the front stands in a hockey rink with "FuboTV" on the sides of the rink and on digital banners on the bleachers, with cheering crowds in the stands. He skates forward towards the camera and says "Getting the best deal on hockey isn't a hat trick..." then stops short, kicking up ice mist into the air, then says "It's just FuboTV." then skates away.
goal: a polished, realistic FuboTV hockey promo: on-camera lines delivered by the player, a hockey stop with ice spray, legible FuboTV branding
title: FuboTV: It's Just FuboTV
